Instruction: Generate code that uses the pyaedt library to create a flex cable CPWG (coplanar waveguide with ground) in HFSS. The code should first import necessary libraries and set the non-graphical mode. Then, it should launch AEDT in a specified version and solution type, and set some properties such as material override, automatically use causal materials, open region, model units, and initial mesh. 

Next, the code should define variables for the flex cable CPWG, including total length, theta, radius, width, height, spacing, ground width, and ground thickness. It should also define a function to create a bending based on the curvature radius and extension.

The code should then draw a signal line and a ground line to create a bent signal wire and two bent ground wires respectively. It should also draw a dielectric to create a dielectric cable, and create bottom metals. 

Afterwards, the code should create port interfaces (PEC enclosures) and a Perfect E boundary condition. It should also create ports and a setup and sweep with specified properties. 

Finally, the code should plot the model and release AEDT.

```python
from pyaedt import Hfss
from pyaedt import Desktop
import math

# Set non-graphical mode
nongraphical = True

# Launch AEDT in specified version and solution type
desktop_version = "2024.1"
solution_type = "DrivenModal"
d = Desktop(desktop_version, non_graphical=nongraphical, new_desktop_session=True)
hfss = Hfss(projectname="FlexCPWG", designname="CPWG_Flex", solution_type=solution_type, specified_version=desktop_version)

# Set properties
hfss.change_material_override(True)
hfss.change_automatically_use_causal_materials(True)
hfss.create_open_region()
hfss.model_units = "mm"
hfss.initial_mesh_settings(max_length=2, max_init_mesh_edge_length=2)

# Define variables for flex cable CPWG
total_length = 100  # mm
theta = 90  # degrees
radius = 30  # mm
signal_width = 1  # mm
signal_height = 0.035  # mm
spacing = 0.2  # mm
ground_width = 3  # mm
ground_thickness = 0.035  # mm
dielectric_height = 0.2  # mm
dielectric_material = "Polyimide"

hfss["total_length"] = "{}mm".format(total_length)
hfss["theta"] = "{}deg".format(theta)
hfss["radius"] = "{}mm".format(radius)
hfss["signal_width"] = "{}mm".format(signal_width)
hfss["signal_height"] = "{}mm".format(signal_height)
hfss["spacing"] = "{}mm".format(spacing)
hfss["ground_width"] = "{}mm".format(ground_width)
hfss["ground_thickness"] = "{}mm".format(ground_thickness)
hfss["dielectric_height"] = "{}mm".format(dielectric_height)

# Function to create a bent polyline (arc + straight)
def create_bent_line(hfss, name, start, theta, radius, extension, width, height, mat="copper"):
    # Arc segment
    arc = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(
        [
            start,
            ["{}+radius*cos(theta*PI/180)".format(start[0]), "{}+radius*sin(theta*PI/180)".format(start[1]), start[2]],
            ["{}+radius".format(start[0]), "{}".format(start[1]), start[2]]
        ],
        name=name+"_arc",
        xsection_type="Rectangle",
        xsection_width=width,
        xsection_height=height,
        matname=mat,
        close_polyline=False
    )
    # Straight segment
    end_x = "{}+radius+{}".format(start[0], extension)
    straight = hfss.modeler.create_polyline(
        [
            ["{}+radius".format(start[0]), "{}".format(start[1]), start[2]],
            [end_x, "{}".format(start[1]), start[2]]
        ],
        name=name+"_straight",
        xsection_type="Rectangle",
        xsection_width=width,
        xsection_height=height,
        matname=mat,
        close_polyline=False
    )
    # Unite arc and straight
    hfss.modeler.unite([arc, straight])
    return arc

# Draw signal line (center)
signal_start = [0, 0, dielectric_height]
signal = create_bent_line(
    hfss,
    "signal",
    signal_start,
    theta,
    radius,
    total_length - math.radians(theta) * radius,
    signal_width,
    signal_height
)

# Draw ground lines (left and right)
ground_offset = (signal_width / 2) + spacing + (ground_width / 2)
ground_left_start = [0, -ground_offset, dielectric_height]
ground_right_start = [0, ground_offset, dielectric_height]

ground_left = create_bent_line(
    hfss,
    "ground_left",
    ground_left_start,
    theta,
    radius,
    total_length - math.radians(theta) * radius,
    ground_width,
    ground_thickness
)
ground_right = create_bent_line(
    hfss,
    "ground_right",
    ground_right_start,
    theta,
    radius,
    total_length - math.radians(theta) * radius,
    ground_width,
    ground_thickness
)

# Draw dielectric cable
dielectric_length = total_length + 2  # mm, add margin
dielectric_width = 2 * (ground_offset + ground_width / 2) + 1  # mm, add margin
dielectric_box = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [-1, -dielectric_width / 2, 0],
    [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, dielectric_height],
    name="dielectric",
    matname=dielectric_material
)

# Create bottom metals (ground plane under signal and grounds)
bottom_plane = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    [-1, -dielectric_width / 2, 0],
    [dielectric_length, dielectric_width, ground_thickness],
    name="bottom_ground",
    matname="copper"
)

# Create port interfaces (PEC enclosures)
pec1 = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[-1, -dielectric_width / 2, dielectric_height / 2],
    dimension_list=[dielectric_width, dielectric_height],
    name="pec1",
    matname="pec"
)
pec2 = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[dielectric_length, -dielectric_width / 2, dielectric_height / 2],
    dimension_list=[dielectric_width, dielectric_height],
    name="pec2",
    matname="pec"
)

# Assign Perfect E boundary to PEC sheets
hfss.assign_perfecte_to_sheets(["pec1", "pec2"])

# Create ports
hfss.create_wave_port_from_sheet("pec1", integration_line=None, name="port1")
hfss.create_wave_port_from_sheet("pec2", integration_line=None, name="port2")

# Create setup and sweep
setup = hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "10GHz"
setup.props["PortsOnly"] = False
setup.props["MaximumPasses"] = 10
setup.props["MinimumPasses"] = 1
setup.props["MinimumConvergedPasses"] = 1
setup.props["PercentRefinement"] = 30
setup.props["BasisOrder"] = 1
setup.props["MinimumFrequency"] = "1GHz"
setup.props["MaximumDeltaS"] = 0.01
setup.update()

sweep = setup.add_sweep("Sweep1")
sweep.props["RangeType"] = "LinearStep"
sweep.props["RangeStart"] = "1GHz"
sweep.props["RangeEnd"] = "20GHz"
sweep.props["RangeStep"] = "0.5GHz"
sweep.props["Type"] = "Fast"
sweep.update()

# Plot the model
hfss.plot(show=True)

# Release AEDT
hfss.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
